meta.guide_tau: Level caption:  energy (NIST, or a measurement of the last 20 years where one exists) and measured lifetime (where one exists).
meta.notes: Literature search was limited: the session's web-search quota was exhausted, so sources were located through Crossref, HAL, OSTI, arXiv and NASA ADS queries and only open copies could be read. Ground-term hyperfine constants are second-hand from Chichinin's JPCRD review (method 'compilation'); the King & Jaccarino 1954 numbers were read on the APS abstract page. B < 0 for both isotopes as printed. The M1 A value is the calculated one adopted by NIST. Two-photon entries: wavelength_vac_nm is the laser wavelength. Second pass (2026-10-01): the measured lifetime of the TALIF upper level was found in the abstract reproduced by OSTI/INIS (ETDEWEB record 22362940). Third pass (2026-10-02): added the five 4p5 2P - 5s vacuum-ultraviolet resonance lines with measured A values. NIST's transition-probability reference T3064 for these lines was checked to be Tellinghuisen & Clyne 1976, the hyperfine-corrected re-analysis of the Clyne & Townsend 1974 absorption measurements; the uncorrected 1974 oscillator strengths (read in the abstract on the archived RSC page) are kept as alternatives, converted to A (derived). Morton 2000 (saved as pdf/Br_Morton_2000.pdf) states that the 1976 paper corrected the 1974 one.
